name: Berserker · Knight style A (both eyes)
description: A faithful redraw of Ulfric in the plumed Knight’s style. He wears a grey-brown wolf’s head as a hood (ears up, the snout and fangs over his brow, an amber wolf’s eye), and its pelt runs on down his back into a two-lobed fur cape with the wolf’s pale-tipped tail swinging beneath it. Under the snout: a shadowed brow, two fierce eyes and a big red beard braided through a gold ring, the one strong accent. Bare, heavy arms in sun-browned skin with leather bracers, a dark leather jerkin with a strap and gold stud, a belt and a kilt of leather strips, fur-wrapped shins. Broader and heavier than the Knight at the Knight’s height. He holds two bearded axes up and out, ready; their steel heads carry a 1 px bright edge. Idle: a heavy breath with the cape rippling and the tail swaying a beat behind. Walk: a planted stride, the axes swinging against the legs, cape and tail streaming. Attack: he gathers, raises both axes overhead, cocks them back behind his head, then crashes them down on frame 19 inside a wide white crescent, the axes biting the ground and throwing up chips, and recovers. No black outline: every edge is a dark tone of its own material, all ramps hue-shifted. The head is turned a little toward the viewer, so both eyes show under the wolf’s snout (near eye, a pixel of light skin at the bridge, far eye, the far cheek past it), with the nose just under them.
